piercing.title: Piercing pieces forged for the body.
piercing.intro: Septums, labrets, plugs, tunnels and curated daily pieces in ASTM F-136 implant-grade titanium and 925 silver. Bio-compatible. Hypo-allergenic. Lifetime safe in the body.
piercing.p1: Every piercing leaves the studio with the same care it would receive from a professional piercer — sterilized, gauged correctly, packed discreet. We do not mass-produce.
piercing.p2: Available zones include septum, eyebrow, lip, nostril, helix, conch, tragus and lobe (4g and below). For zones below 4g, see our ear weights collection.

hangers.title: Hangers worn as signal.
hangers.intro: Sculptural pendants and ceremonial hangers, forged in titanium, silver and bronze. Each piece weighted for the body, balanced for the wearer.
hangers.p1: Our hanger line ranges from minimal silver crescents to heavy ammonite-and-bronze sculptural pieces. All are made for stretched lobes and adapted-gauge wearers.
hangers.p2: Most hangers are one-of-a-kind or small-batch. When a piece sells, the next iteration is a different stone, a different angle, a different intention.

amulets.title: Amulets carried close to the body.
amulets.intro: Cosmic-symbol pendants in sterling silver, 14k gold and Atacama meteorite. Each amulet is a portal — small in scale, weighted in meaning.
amulets.p1: Our amulets translate ancestral cosmologies into metal: the four cardinal forces, the volcanic line, the sky world. They are made to be worn daily, against the skin, until they take on the rhythm of the body that carries them.
amulets.p2: Most amulets are one-of-a-kind or forged in editions of three or fewer. When a piece sells, the next iteration is a different stone, a different proportion, a different intention.

ear_weights.eyebrow: EAR WEIGHTS · CALIBRATED FOR STRETCHED LOBES
ear_weights.title: Ear weights balanced for the body.
ear_weights.intro: Sculpted weights for stretched lobes from 4g downward — in titanium, sterling silver, bronze and selected stone. Calibrated for safe wear, balanced for the wearer.
ear_weights.p1: Each weight is forged with the lobe in mind: distribution of mass, surface contact, hook radius. We do not exceed safe-wear thresholds for stretched tissue. If a piece would harm a healthy lobe, we don't make it.
ear_weights.p2: Ear weights live in a slow rotation. Many pieces are limited or one-of-a-kind. New pairs and singles are forged in small batches and announced to the circle first.

ritual_objects.title: Objects for the body and the ceremony.
ritual_objects.intro: Vessels, talismans, hand pieces and ceremonial adornments — forged in silver, bronze, stone and wood. Made for presence, not display.
ritual_objects.p1: Ritual objects extend beyond what is worn: incense holders, hand-held talismans, pieces designed for altar or threshold. Each one carries the same hand and material standards as our body jewelry.
ritual_objects.p2: These pieces are infrequent. They are made when the studio finds the right material and the right hour. We do not promise a release calendar — we announce a piece when it is ready to leave the workshop.

material_sterling_silver.title: Sterling Silver 950 — pure, durable, alive with light.
material_sterling_silver.intro: Pure, durable, and alive with light.
material_sterling_silver.p1: Sterling Silver 950 is our standard silver alloy — 95% pure silver, 5% copper. It carries more weight, more brightness, and more longevity than the more common 925. Used by Mapuche silversmiths for centuries in ceremonial pieces. We pour, hammer, and finish it by hand in our Truckee studio.
material_sterling_silver.p2: Every piece is hand-finished — the surface tells you who made it. Small variations between units are part of the material's nature. Polished or oxidized finish per piece.

material_14k_gold.title: 14k Gold — heirloom-grade, made to outlast the wearer.
material_14k_gold.intro: Heirloom-grade. Warm. Made to outlast the wearer.
material_14k_gold.p1: 14k gold is our long-game material — used for the pieces meant to leave the workshop and stay in a family. Sourced from certified suppliers in the United States. Available in yellow, rose and white finish. We work it for commissions and a small number of author-series signets and amulets.
material_14k_gold.p2: Each 14k piece is forged from solid alloy — no plating. Hand-set, hand-finished, with care to avoid contamination of the metal during work.

material_titanium.title: Implant-grade titanium — ASTM F-136.
material_titanium.intro: Hypoallergenic, durable, lightweight. The international standard for body-safe jewelry. Bio-compatible. Non-reactive.
material_titanium.p1: Every piece labeled "piercing" on this site is forged from ASTM F-136 implant-grade titanium — the same material used in surgical implants. Bio-compatible. Will not corrode. Will not provoke an allergic reaction. Stays in healing piercings without irritation.
material_titanium.p2: Titanium is harder to forge than silver or gold; we mill, anodize and finish each piece in-studio. Anodized colors are non-coating — they're light interference on the metal surface itself, will not flake.

material_vacamuerta.title: Vacamuerta meteorite — cosmic fragments, 4.5 billion years old.
material_vacamuerta.intro: Cosmic fragments that fell in Chile's Atacama Desert. Each piece carries 4.5 billion years of history.
material_vacamuerta.p1: Vacamuerta is our name for the iron-nickel meteorites recovered from Chile's Atacama Desert. The Atacama is the driest non-polar desert on Earth — meteorites that fall there are preserved instead of weathering away. The fragments we use are sourced through verified Chilean cooperatives that document chain of custody.
material_vacamuerta.p2: Each meteorite piece is set by hand into silver or gold — never glued, never dyed. The Widmanstätten pattern (the cross-hatched crystalline grain visible inside iron-nickel meteorites) is etched and stabilized so the piece reveals its 4.5-billion-year structure on the surface.

material_walnut_wood.title: Walnut & tropical wood — sustainably sourced, warm, grounded.
material_walnut_wood.p1: We work primarily in American black walnut and select tropical hardwoods. All wood is sourced from certified sustainable suppliers — no rainforest extraction. Each plank is selected for grain, density and resistance to swelling.
material_walnut_wood.p2: Wood pieces are turned, sanded and oiled by hand. The natural finish darkens with skin oils over time — this is part of the material's life. We do not stain or lacquer; the grain has to speak for itself.

material_brass_bronze.title: Brass & bronze — bold ancestral metals.
material_brass_bronze.intro: Bold ancestral metals with deep tribal roots.
material_brass_bronze.p1: Brass and bronze are the oldest jewelry metals on the human record — worked since the bronze age, named in ritual contexts across continents. We use them for ear weights, hangers and ceremonial objects where weight and patina are the point.
material_brass_bronze.p2: Cast or hammered, then hand-finished. We do not seal brass or bronze — patina is invited, not prevented. Each piece becomes a record of its wearer.

material_hub.title: Six materials, six origins.
material_hub.intro: We work in six material families. Each carries its own provenance and its own behavior on the body.
material_hub.lede: We do not work in materials we cannot vouch for. Every piece names its material, names its provenance, and names what to expect of it on the body.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: Wenu Mapu — upper land, sky world. A small jewelry studio in Truckee, California, forging body jewelry by hand from titanium, silver, wood and stone.

story.heading: From the southern Andes to the Sierra Nevada.
story.p1: Wenu Mapu was born in southern Chile and now operates from a small workshop in Truckee, California. We forge body jewelry by hand — titanium, silver, gold, wood, stone, meteorite — with patience and intention.
story.p2: Our pieces are not products. They are objects of passage: things you wear close to the body to remember who you are, where you come from, what you are becoming.
story.p3: Every piece leaves the studio touched only by the hands that made it. No middlemen. No borrowed shelves.

process.heading: How a commission moves.
process.intro: From first inquiry to delivered piece — usually six months. We do not rush a commission. The wait is part of what gives the piece weight.

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.body: You write to us: zone, idea, references, intention. We respond within 5 business days with a yes or no — we accept a limited number of commissions per quarter.

steps.title: Concept call
steps.body: Video or email exchange. We align on symbolism, materials, scale, body zone and timing. No charge at this stage.

steps.title: Sketch & quote
steps.body: We send 1–2 hand sketches and a formal written quote with material breakdown. You approve, ask for revisions, or step away — no obligation.

steps.title: 50% deposit
steps.body: On approval, a 50% non-refundable deposit reserves your slot in the queue and confirms the commission. Production starts after deposit clears.

steps.title: Forging
steps.body: We forge, file, set, polish. You receive 2–3 progress images during this period. Total studio time: 6 months from inquiry.

steps.title: Final balance & delivery
steps.body: Final 50% balance due before shipping. We ship insured (USPS Priority within US, DHL international) or hand-deliver in Truckee.

terms.heading: What you should know.
items: **Lead time**: 6 months from accepted inquiry to delivery. Plan accordingly.
**Deposit**: 50% non-refundable on commission confirmation. The remaining 50% is due before shipping.
**Revisions**: Two rounds of sketch revision included in quote. Further revisions billed hourly.
**Cancellation**: After deposit, you may cancel; deposit is forfeit and covers materials and design time. Before deposit, no cost to you.
**Materials**: Sterling Silver 925 and Gold 14k for the metalwork. Stones, wood, meteorite or specialty inclusions are quoted separately.
**Shipping & duties**: Shipping insured at quoted cost. International duties are buyer's responsibility.
**Warranty**: All commissions covered by lifetime workshop repair on manufacturing defects. Wear-and-tear is not covered.

sizing.title: Sizing guide.
sizing.intro: Body jewelry uses two systems: gauge (thickness of the post) and diameter (size of the ring or stretched lobe). Below is the full conversion chart we use in the studio.

gauge_table.use: Most ear cartilage, septum, lip, eyebrow

sizing.diameter_intro: Inner diameter (ID) is the distance across the inside of the ring. Most adults wear 8–10mm for septum, 6–8mm for helix, 8–12mm for daith.
sizing.post_intro: Length is measured from one ball/disc to the other (post only, excluding ends). When in doubt, measure a current piece with calipers — or send us a photo and we'll help.
sizing.note: If you're in doubt, write to us with the dimensions of a piece you currently wear. We size every order before shipping.
sizing.cta_intro: Browse pieces filtered by gauge, request a custom size on a commission, or write to us with the measurements of a piece you already wear.

care.title: Healing times by zone.
care.intro: Healing is not a deadline — it's a passage. Times below are average ranges for healthy tissue. Listen to your body, follow your piercer's instructions, and never change jewelry before the wound has fully closed at every layer.
care.disclaimer: These ranges are educational, not medical advice. Consult a licensed piercer or healthcare provider for your specific case.

principles.title: Saline, not soap
principles.body: Sterile saline (0.9%) sprayed twice daily. No alcohol, hydrogen peroxide, or harsh soaps — they damage healing tissue.

principles.title: Don't twist, don't sleep on it
principles.body: Touching, twisting, or pressure delays healing and invites bumps. Sleep on a clean pillow on the opposite side.

principles.title: First jewelry stays in
principles.body: The initial piece must remain until the wound is fully healed at every layer. Changing too early restarts the clock or causes rejection.
